def _read_lines_window(path: str, target_line: int, radius: int = 2, max_lines: int = 50000) -> Tuple[List[str], Optional[str], int]:
    lines_window: List[str] = []
    actual_line: Optional[str] = None
    total_lines = 0
    start = max(1, target_line - radius)
    end = target_line + radius
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for i, line in enumerate(f, start=1):
            if i > max_lines:
                break
            total_lines = i
            if start <= i <= end:
                lines_window.append(line)
            if i == target_line:
